summary: label-assigner.sh is well-engineered (proper set -euo pipefail, quoting, glob-to-regex logic, sorted unique output). Workflow structure is sound. However, missing required validation: no actionlint or shellcheck steps in workflow/pipeline. run-act-tests.sh has repetitive test case structure (lines 160–175, 183–207, 215–235 follow identical pattern; could consolidate into parameterized loop or helper). Limited coverage: 3 test cases vs broader edge-case exploration. TDD approach not demonstrated.
